summary: @servicetitan/eslint-plugin-folder-schema ships preinstall dropper that executes obfuscated payload under Bun
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it, marks it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js — a ~730KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript file bundled alongside (Bun-compiled header, string-array rotation loop, ~1000-entry mixed numeric/char-code lookup table, hex-mangled _0xNNNN identifiers). math_init.js and setup.mjs are not declared in package.json's files array (['dist','src']), so they are smuggled tarball content outside the advertised manifest. The package's stated purpose is an ESLint plugin, which has no legitimate need for the Bun runtime at install time or for a heavily obfuscated 'math_init' payload. The preinstall path fires automatically on npm install, so the obfuscated Bun-executed payload runs on every installer's machine as a side effect of resolving this dependency.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
